title: Storage and Data Services
description: Use Azure Blob Storage, Azure Files, Queues, Table Storage, and managed disks from applications.
longDescription: This module teaches Azure storage services from a developer perspective. You will learn how to store blobs, files, queues, and table data; secure access with SAS tokens and managed identities; configure lifecycle and redundancy; and integrate storage services with applications.
whatYouLearn: Upload and download blobs with SDKs and CLI
Use SAS tokens and managed identities for secure access
Share files with Azure Files and mount from apps
Choose the right redundancy and private connectivity options
